info.title: DigitDNS Core REST API v3
info.description:
DigitDNS Core REST API v3 is the full-parity contract: every capability the dashboard exposes is reachable over REST. Authenticate with a login session (POST /api/v3/auth/login with username/password, plus a TOTP code when two-factor is on) or with the master REST key in X-API-Key. Session tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer digitdns_session_...

The API is mounted below the installation's hidden admin path. The docs page derives that prefix automatically; a script should read it from the panel URL or use the master key against the same prefix.

Conventions: RFC 9457 application/problem+json errors; list endpoints answer {items,next_cursor} with a bounded limit; resource DTOs use symmetric field names; sub-resource verbs are POST /{resource}/{id}/actions/{action}; unknown JSON fields are refused. Endpoints marked dashboard-delegated mirror the corresponding panel operation through the same server-side implementation, so the REST answer and the button cannot drift.

Rate and exposure: the API is gated by the server's api_bind rule. A live dashboard session may read the docs page through its HttpOnly document cookie; every other caller must be admitted by api_bind.

servers.description: Paths are relative to the installation's admin prefix; prepend /<admin> when calling directly. The docs page fills this in automatically.

BearerAuth.description: Master key or a digitdns_session_ token from /auth/login.

content.description: Uploaded hosts/Adblock text, up to 20 MB.

code.description: TOTP code, required only when two-factor is enabled.

token.description: A digitdns_session_ token; send it as Authorization: Bearer.

total_queries.description: Queries served for this account since it was created.

last_seen.description: Last time a query was served for this account; omitted when it has never been seen.

next_traffic_reset.description: When the traffic allowance next rolls over; omitted when no reset cycle is set.

default_egress.description: Fallback exit when no domain override or service default applies: "" for This Server, an agent ID, or "egress:<id>".

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry; wins over validity_days. The zero timestamp 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means lifetime.

default_egress.description: Fallback exit when no domain override or service default applies: "" for This Server, an agent ID, or "egress:<id>".

uuid.description: Replacement UUID. Omit to leave unchanged.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry. Omit to leave unchanged; send 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z to clear it (lifetime).

default_egress.description: Fallback exit when no domain override or service default applies: "" for This Server, an agent ID, or "egress:<id>".

active_clients_approx.description: True only when the range includes pre-HLL buckets and the count fell back to the bounded top-client union.

action.description: The action the live matcher would take.

rule.description: The matching entry or pattern, or empty when nothing matched.

pattern.description: How the rule matched: exact, wildcard or none.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country for this server, when known.

transport.description: Legacy single-value form of transports. any, encrypted or regular.

transports.description: Enabled upstream protocols. At least one must be present.

default_strategy.description: adaptive (periodic fastest, the default), sequential (in order), hedged or best (Best Known). The retired fastest value is accepted and normalised to hedged; an empty value now reads as adaptive.

adaptive_interval_minutes.description: How often Adaptive re-benchmarks the pool. Defaults to 60.

adaptive_last_run.description: When the last Adaptive benchmark completed.

adaptive_current.description: The resolver Adaptive is using until the next run.

adaptive_last_latency_ms.description: Measured latency of the Adaptive choice at the last run.

adaptive_last_note.description: Why the last Adaptive run kept or changed the resolver.

mode.description: image pulls and recreates the container; binary swaps the running binary until the next recreate.

get.description: Returns the running build's version, channel, commit hash and Go runtime. This is the one route that needs no credential; the dashboard's About line and the update card both read it.
Returns the live daemon status: listener state, uptime, query counters and the current configuration generation. Poll it for a lightweight health view; use /stats for the dashboard's telemetry.

post.summary: Log in and mint a session

401.description: Invalid credentials (twofactor_required=true when only the code is missing/failing)

post.description: Exchanges a username/password pair, plus a TOTP code when 2FA is enabled, for a digitdns_session_ token. Send the token as Authorization: Bearer on later calls. A 401 carrying twofactor_required=true means the password was accepted and the code is missing.
Revokes the presented session token. The master REST key is not a session and cannot be logged out.

get.description: Returns the authenticated identity, whether the password is still the default, and the 2FA state. The dashboard calls it on boot to decide whether to show the security setup modal.

post.description: Clears login lockouts for one address, or for every address when ip is empty. This is the recovery route: it accepts the master REST key as well as a session.

get.description: Reports whether TOTP is enabled and whether an enrollment is open. It never returns the secret or the otpauth URI; those leave the process only in the password-gated setup response.

post.description: Starts a TOTP enrollment and returns a fresh secret and otpauth URI. The current password is required. Calling it again replaces the pending secret.
Confirms an open enrollment with a current code. On success the secret is promoted, 2FA is enabled and every existing session is revoked.
Turns TOTP off. Both the current password and a current code are required, and every session is revoked.
Mints a one-time ticket for the SSE log stream. EventSource cannot send an Authorization header, so the ticket is passed as ?ticket= and is consumed by the first connection.

get.description: Lists subscriber clients with cursor pagination. Each item carries quota, expiry, policy assignments and live traffic counters.

post.description: Creates a client. The body may set a UUID, name, quota, absolute expiry, allowed addresses and custom policies; omitted fields take the server defaults.

get.description: Returns one client by UUID or name, including the live traffic counters the dashboard's client table shows.

patch.description: Partially updates a client. Only the supplied fields change; sending an empty body is a no-op.

put.description: Full-update alias for PATCH. The same fields are accepted; omitted fields are left unchanged so a dashboard save cannot erase a quota by accident.

delete.description: Deletes a client and its address bindings. The subscriber portal token and any active sessions for that client stop working immediately.

post.description: Runs a client action: enable, disable, renew, reset-traffic, add-ip or remove-ip. The action vocabulary matches the dashboard's row menu.

get.description: Lists the named policy records and their rule assignments.

post.description: Stores or replaces one policy entry. The body is the same policy shape the dashboard's policy editor posts.

get.description: Lists custom client groups and their icon metadata.

post.description: Creates a custom group. A group is a named set of clients used by policy rules.

put.description: Updates a custom group's name, description or icon.

delete.description: Deletes a custom group. Clients keep existing but lose the group assignment.

get.description: Lists relay agents, their connection state, last heartbeat and assigned domains. The clear key is never included.

post.description: Creates a relay agent and returns its clear key exactly once. Store the key before leaving the response.

put.description: Edits an agent's name, address or assignment metadata.

delete.summary: Delete a relay agent and prune its assignments
delete.description: Deletes an agent and prunes its domain assignments.

post.description: Enables a relay agent so the hub may assign work to it.
Disables a relay agent. Existing assignments stop; the record and key remain.

get.description: Returns the agent's clear key for an operator who needs to reinstall the agent. Treat the response as a credential.

post.description: Rotates the agent key. The old key stops working immediately; the new clear key is returned once.
Opens a TCP connection to the agent's relay endpoint and reports latency and the failure reason, mirroring the dashboard's Test button.

get.description: Returns the four custom rule sets (proxied, proxied-disabled, blocked and direct) plus DNS rewrite records.

put.description: Saves rule sets. A partial body merges into the existing sets; send an empty array to clear one set.

get.description: Returns the access policy: allow-all mode, allowed networks and DoH/DoQ token lists.

put.description: Saves the access policy. DoH/DoQ tokens take effect immediately.

post.description: Sets allow_all. This is the one-field shortcut the dashboard's access toggle uses.

get.description: Lists the resolver pool in priority order.

post.description: Adds an upstream address. The address may carry a transport prefix (tls://, https://, quic://, sdns://) and is validated before it is stored.

get.summary: List curated public DNS providers and their supported transports
get.description: Returns the curated public-resolver catalogue with each provider's supported transports and endpoints.

delete.summary: Remove an upstream (id is the address)
delete.description: Removes an upstream. The id is the address exactly as listed.

post.description: Starts a latency benchmark of the pool. The run is asynchronous; poll /upstreams/stats for the results.
Reorders the resolver pool. The body is the complete ordered address list.

get.summary: Read ad-blocking status, installed lists and preset catalogue
get.description: Returns the ad-blocking policy, installed lists, preset catalogue and current status.

post.description: Saves the ad-blocking policy: enabled flag, block response, TTL, refresh interval and allowlist.

put.description: PUT alias for the same policy save.

post.description: Starts a background refresh of every enabled blocklist.

get.description: Lists the curated blocklist presets with their install state.

post.description: Installs one or more presets by id. The body is {ids:[...]}.

post.summary: Add a custom URL subscription or uploaded list
post.description: Adds a custom URL subscription or uploads a hosts/Adblock list body.

patch.description: Enables or disables one blocklist without deleting its stored rules.

post.description: POST alias for enable/disable.

delete.summary: Delete a blocklist and its stored rules
delete.description: Deletes a blocklist and the rules it stored.

post.summary: Refresh one blocklist in the background
post.description: Refreshes one blocklist in the background.

get.description: Returns the server settings record: admin path, API exposure, ports and session policy.

post.description: Updates the server settings. Changing credentials or the admin path revokes sessions.

get.description: Returns the subscriber-portal settings: domain, port, title and theme source.

post.description: Saves the subscriber-portal settings.

get.summary: Read the DNSSEC validation policy and trust anchors
get.description: Returns the DNSSEC validation policy and configured trust anchors.

post.description: Saves the DNSSEC policy. Validation changes are startup-only and take effect after a restart.

get.summary: Read the live proxy leak protection policy
get.description: Returns the live proxy leak protection policy.

post.summary: Save the live proxy leak protection policy
post.description: Saves the proxy leak protection policy; the change is live.

get.description: Returns the current master REST key. The dashboard masks it; this endpoint is how the reveal button fills the field.

post.summary: Rotate the master API key (current_password + code)
post.description: Rotates the master REST key. The current password and a current TOTP code are required when 2FA is on.
Generates a new hidden admin path. Every old bookmark and session under the old path stops working; confirm=true is required.

post.summary: Store a domain and start Let's Encrypt issuance

cert_name.description: ACME identifier; may be a wildcard such as *.example.com.

post.description: Stores a domain and starts Let's Encrypt issuance. The run is asynchronous; poll /tls/acme/status.
Sets the DoH/DoT certificate auto-renew preference.

get.description: Returns the current ACME issuance progress, last detail and error.
Returns the live telemetry document the dashboard polls: QPS, cache hit rate, clients, upstreams and listener state.

get.summary: Aggregated DNS totals for a range
get.description: Returns aggregated DNS totals for a range: queries, blocked, proxied, cache hits and clients.
Returns the aggregated time series for a range, bucketed at the requested interval.
Returns one ranked aggregate dimension: domains, blocked, clients, upstreams, protocols or relay.

get.summary: Summary, series and every ranked table for a range
get.description: Returns the summary, series and every ranked table for a range in one document.

get.summary: Download a range as CSV or JSON
get.description: Downloads the aggregate history for a range as CSV or JSON.
Returns the aggregate-history policy: retention and sampling.

post.description: Saves the aggregate-history policy. A retention change takes effect after a restart.

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream of live queries. Authenticate with a Bearer token or a one-time ?ticket= from /auth/sse-ticket.
Lists the operator-defined diagnostic targets.

post.summary: Add or replace a diagnostic target
post.description: Adds or replaces a diagnostic target.

delete.summary: Delete a diagnostic target (?host= or body host)
delete.description: Deletes a diagnostic target by ?host= or a JSON body.

post.description: Runs the diagnostic probe against the configured targets and returns the results.
Flushes the DNS cache. In-flight queries are unaffected.

get.description: Returns the full configuration snapshot the dashboard renders: server, DNS, TLS, rules, access and subscription.

post.description: Starts an upstream benchmark. Alias of /upstreams/benchmark.

get.description: Checks the project's main-branch version against the running build. The result is cached for a minute; ?force=1 bypasses the cache.

post.description: Starts a verified self-update in the background. Poll /update/status for progress. Container installs in image mode refuse the in-container swap.

get.description: Returns the live self-update progress.

Swagger UI for this API. A live dashboard session reaches it through the document cookie; other callers need api_bind to allow their address. The spec is inlined, so this page needs no second request.
The OpenAPI 3.0 document for this API. Gated by api_bind, or reachable with a live dashboard document cookie.

get.summary: Test a domain against the live rules
get.description: Asks the live matcher how it would classify a domain. The result names the action, the matching rule and whether an exact entry or a parent wildcard applied. Read-only.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: DNS name to classify, in presentation form (up to 253 characters).

get.description: Returns the GeoIP database status, the resolved country and the database date.

200.description: Database status and the country resolved for this server.

503.description: The GeoIP service is not configured on this install.

post.description: Downloads a fresh GeoIP database and returns the new status.

503.description: The GeoIP service is not configured on this install.

get.description: Returns the default resolution strategy and per-domain overrides.

example.adaptive_last_note: current resolver is still the fastest

post.description: Saves resolution defaults and overrides. PUT is accepted as an alias.

put.description: PUT alias for POST /settings/resolution. The body and response are identical.

post.description: Benchmarks the pool, applies the Adaptive hysteresis, installs the chosen resolver and returns the updated resolution settings. Requires default_strategy=adaptive.

get.description: Returns the client transport settings: DoT, DoH, DoQ, DoH3, DNSCrypt and their ports.

post.description: Saves transport settings and rebinds listeners. PUT is accepted as an alias.

put.description: PUT alias for POST /settings/transports. The body and response are identical.

get.description: Returns per-upstream latency, health and last-probe data for the resolver-racer card.

200.description: One item per resolver in the pool.

post.description: Sets the container update method: image (default, pull/recreate) or binary (temporary in-container swap). A systemd install answers 400.

Discards an enrollment that was started but never confirmed. The pending secret is removed from the settings record; enabling 2FA still requires a fresh setup and confirmation. This is the endpoint behind the settings card's Cancel enrollment button, and it is what keeps the card from re-opening an empty enrollment box after a reload.

get.summary: Certificate source policy and current certificate details
get.description: Returns the certificate-source policy for the panel, DoH/DoT and subscriber portal, plus the certificate details each surface currently serves.

post.description: Validates, writes and hot-applies a PEM pair for the named surface. The private key is never returned.

get.description: Lists hub-side SOCKS5 and WireGuard egresses with health, latency and traffic. Secrets are never returned; password_set and config_set report whether one is stored.

post.description: Creates a SOCKS5 or WireGuard egress. The SOCKS5 password and WireGuard configuration are write-only. Fail-closed defaults to true when omitted.

config.description: WireGuard wg-quick configuration. Write-only; contains the private key.

get.description: Returns one egress with the same secret-free view as the list.

put.description: Updates one egress. Omitted secrets keep their stored value; an empty string clears one.

config.description: WireGuard wg-quick configuration. Write-only; contains the private key.

patch.description: Partial update. Omitted secrets keep their stored value.

config.description: WireGuard wg-quick configuration. Write-only; contains the private key.

delete.description: Deletes an egress. Domains assigned to it fall back unless the egress was fail-closed.

post.description: Opens one probe through the egress and returns ok plus latency_ms, or ok=false with an error.
Includes the egress in routing and health checks.
Stops routing through the egress. A fail-closed egress refuses instead of falling back to the hub.

get.description: Reports whether the DNS policy engine is on. Off means every query resolves directly, without rules, proxying or blocking.

post.description: Turns the DNS policy engine on or off live and persists the choice.

put.description: Turns the DNS policy engine on or off live and persists the choice.

get.description: Returns the newest bounded in-process daemon log lines. The authoritative log remains stderr/journald.
Reports whether this full instance acts as a relay agent for another hub, plus synced catalogue counts and relay traffic.

post.description: Enables or disables full-instance relay mode, stores the hub URL and credential, and syncs the hub catalogue.

put.description: Enables or disables full-instance relay mode, stores the hub URL and credential, and syncs the hub catalogue.

post.description: Performs a real catalogue request against the configured hub and returns ok plus latency_ms, or ok=false with an error.

get.description: Returns the resolver precedence for a domain and optional client IP: action, rule, pattern, blocklist and allowlist detail, custom record, and the relay/egress target.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Client IP used to select the account default egress.

get.description: Returns alert channels, cooldown and enabled event types. Tokens are redacted.

post.description: Saves the alert configuration. A redacted token is merged with the stored one.
Sends a synthetic test alert to every enabled channel.
Master switch for this server acting as a relay. Off stops every hub worker and removes the relay policy.

get.description: Searches the optional persistent query log. Filters: from, to, client, domain, action, proto, limit.
Returns whether the optional query log is enabled, retention, anonymization and size cap.

post.description: Enables or disables the persistent query log and updates retention and anonymization.
Deletes every stored query while keeping the settings.
